ideas.title: Following the Money Trail in Minnesota's SNAP Program
ideas.description: Investigate the fraud in Minnesota's SNAP program and track the money trail to uncover the individuals and organizations involved.
questions: How much money has been stolen?
ideas.insight: This investigation could lead to the discovery of a large-scale fraud scheme and the prosecution of those involved.

ideas.title: The Impact of the Government Shutdown on Fraud Investigations
ideas.description: Examine the impact of the government shutdown on fraud investigations and the potential consequences for public safety and security.
questions: How has the shutdown affected ongoing investigations?
What are the potential consequences for public safety?
ideas.insight: This investigation could highlight the importance of continued funding for fraud investigations and the potential risks of a prolonged shutdown.
